author: Inside Edition
description: Indiana is set to execute a man accused of killing two children in 2010. Governor Mike Braun accepted the parole board's recommendation that Jeffrey Weisheit die by lethal injection on November 5th. The governor has the power to commute the death sentence to life in prison, but he declined to do so. Weisheit was convicted of two counts of capital murder in 2013. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Indiana Governor Won't Stop Nov. 5th Execution Of Jeffrey Weisheit

author: Inside Edition
description: A convicted killer has been captured after nine days on the loose, authorities said Tuesday. Jacob Morley walked out of a Tennessee prison on Oct. 25, wearing his prison uniform. He stole a truck and crossed state lines while on the lam. Morley was serving a life sentence for first-degree murder after police discovered the body of a missing person under his home in 2022.
title: Escaped Murderer Jacob Morley Captured In Missouri

author: Inside Edition
description: This may be the cutest incentive to get out and vote. A polling center in San Diego has provided fluffy mood boosters for those voting on Election Day – adorable puppies. The initiative, arranged by the Helen Woodward Animal Center, is called Paws at the Polls. The hope is that voters can get free cuddles and whiffs of puppy breath and decide to give a pup a forever home.
title: San Diego Polling Center Entices Voters With Adoptable Puppies
